quarterly_data.quarter: Rohm results briefing Q&A: FY2025 Year-End Presentation Q&A (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A, FY2025 year-end presentation): the company expects to achieve its FY26 profit improvement targets (company numbering) as initially anticipated. On the surge in gold prices, it has been passing on price increases since FY26 and is also proceeding with a more structural initiative to substitute copper for gold as a raw material; the effects of the structural reforms will become more significant in FY27 as the reorganization of production sites and the shift to copper progress.

quarterly_data.quarter: Rohm results briefing Q&A: FY2025 Year-End Presentation Q&A (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on the planned integration: although not yet at the stage of disclosing details, ROHM and Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage aim to integrate their entire semiconductor businesses, and for power semiconductors the three companies including Mitsubishi Electric aim to establish a globally competitive business entity. If the merger goes through, the production strategy would be revised in line with the changed manufacturing site structure; in power devices the company would move toward larger wafer sizes, transitioning from 6-inch to 8-inch or 12-inch wafers. Because Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage has high-performance Si MOSFETs for data centers, management sees potential for sales growth in that sector.
quarterly_data.figure: 6-inch to 8-inch or 12-inch wafers (power devices, if the merger proceeds)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rohm results briefing Q&A: FY2025 Year-End Presentation Q&A (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on automotive SiC demand after domestic automotive OEMs revised their BEV production plans: based on current projections the company expects the impact of the revised plans to become apparent in 2029 or later; until 2028 the decline in EV demand will be offset by increased adoption of SiC in HEVs, so there is no significant change to the overall outlook versus previous projections. Many of the revised plans were scheduled to begin in 2029 or later, so the company does not anticipate receiving any related compensation.
quarterly_data.figure: BEV plan revision impact expected 2029 or later

quarterly_data.quarter: Rohm results briefing Q&A: FY2025 Year-End Presentation Q&A (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A), asked about the SiC business's path back to profitability in FY28 (company numbering) shown in its materials: the reduction in depreciation expenses resulting from the impairment loss has taken effect and the break-even point has fallen below the previous estimate; the chart is included solely to illustrate the path toward profitability, and if the SiC business achieves profitability, the profit level for FY28 may exceed the previous estimate.
quarterly_data.figure: SiC break-even point below the previous estimate; FY28 (company numbering) profit may exceed the previous estimate

quarterly_data.quarter: Rohm results briefing Q&A: FY2025 Year-End Presentation Q&A (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on DrMOS and MPC for AI servers: rather than custom products for specific customers, they are positioned as versatile standard products that can be scaled out to other companies; interfaces vary by GPU or CPU but the underlying chip can be standardized, and the company ultimately aims for products that support multiple vendors with the same chip. On capacity, it does not anticipate the need for large-scale investment until 2028; after that it will consider capital expenditures and outsourcing depending on demand trends. On competition from other analog makers, customers sometimes require compatibility such as pin configurations, and competing products can be a prerequisite for selling the company's product.

quarterly_data.quarter: Rohm results briefing Q&A: FY2025 Year-End Presentation Q&A (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on DENSO: in analog ICs, where the two currently collaborate, DENSO has highly reliable technologies developed in the automotive market, and combining these with ROHM's sales channels could jointly develop new markets in the industrial and consumer sectors. Because DENSO is collaborating with other companies in the power sector, ROHM will focus the collaboration on analog.
